api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Assets: List Fixed Assets

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports AssetNumber, AssetDescription, BookTypeCode, AssetCategoryId, AssetType, LifecycleState, MajorCategory. Example: q=BookTypeCode='OPS CORP' and LifecycleState='ACTIVE'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: books, assignments, depreciation, invoices
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of fixed assets across all asset books. Filter by book, category, or lifecycle state.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Assets: Get a Fixed Asset

api_arguments.AssetId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the fixed asset.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: books, assignments, invoices, retirements, revaluations
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific fixed asset including financial book information, location assignments, and depreciation details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Assets: Add a Fixed Asset

api_arguments.AssetNumber: string: Asset number. Auto-generated if not provided.
api_arguments.AssetType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of asset. Valid values: CAPITALIZED, EXPENSED, CIP (Construction in Progress).
api_arguments.DatePlacedInService: [REQUIRED] string: Date the asset was placed into service. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.BookTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the asset book. Example: 'OPS CORP'.
api_arguments.Cost: [REQUIRED] number: Original cost of the asset.
api_arguments.CurrencyCode: [REQUIRED] string: Currency of the asset cost. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.DepreciationMethod: string: Depreciation method code. Example: 'STL' for Straight Line.
api_arguments.Life: integer: Asset useful life in months.
api_arguments.SalvageValue: number: Residual/salvage value at the end of useful life.
api_arguments.SerialNumber: string: Manufacturer serial number of the asset.
api_arguments.ModelNumber: string: Model number of the asset.
api_arguments.AssignedTo: integer: PersonId of the employee the asset is assigned to.
api_arguments.LocationId: integer: Location identifier where the asset is physically located.

functionality: Creates a new fixed asset record and adds it to the specified asset book.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Asset Books: Get Asset Book Details

api_arguments.AssetId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the fixed asset.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports BookTypeCode, LifecycleState. Example: q=BookTypeCode='OPS CORP'
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves financial book details for a fixed asset, including cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and depreciation method.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Asset Retirements: Retire an Asset

api_arguments.AssetId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the asset to retire.
api_arguments.BookTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Asset book from which the asset is being retired.
api_arguments.RetirementDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date of the retirement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.RetirementConventionCode: string: Retirement convention. Example: 'HY' for half-year.
api_arguments.UnitsRetired: number: Number of units being retired. Defaults to all units.
api_arguments.CostRetired: number: Cost amount being retired. Defaults to full asset cost.
api_arguments.ProceedsOfSale: number: Proceeds received from sale of the asset.
api_arguments.RemovalCost: number: Cost incurred to remove or dispose of the asset.
api_arguments.GainLossAccount: string: Account segment string to post the gain or loss on disposal.

functionality: Records the retirement (disposal) of a fixed asset from an asset book, calculating gain or loss on disposal.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Asset Transfers: Transfer an Asset

api_arguments.AssetId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the asset to transfer.
api_arguments.BookTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Asset book for the transfer.
api_arguments.TransferDate: [REQUIRED] string: Effective date of the transfer. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.FromDepartmentId: integer: Source cost center or department identifier.
api_arguments.ToDepartmentId: [REQUIRED] integer: Destination cost center or department identifier.
api_arguments.FromAssignedTo: integer: PersonId of the current asset custodian.
api_arguments.ToAssignedTo: integer: PersonId of the new asset custodian.
api_arguments.UnitsTransferred: number: Number of units to transfer. Defaults to all units.

functionality: Transfers a fixed asset between departments, locations, or employees, updating the asset assignment and depreciation charge accounts.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Asset Adjustments: Adjust Asset Cost

api_arguments.AssetId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the asset to adjust.
api_arguments.BookTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Asset book for the adjustment.
api_arguments.TransactionDate: [REQUIRED] string: Effective date of the adjustment. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.AdjustmentType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of adjustment. Valid values: COST, LIFE, SALVAGE_VALUE, DEPRECIATION_METHOD.
api_arguments.NewCost: number: Updated cost of the asset. Required when AdjustmentType is COST.
api_arguments.NewLife: integer: Updated useful life in months. Required when AdjustmentType is LIFE.
api_arguments.NewSalvageValue: number: Updated salvage value. Required when AdjustmentType is SALVAGE_VALUE.
api_arguments.NewDepreciationMethod: string: Updated depreciation method code. Required when AdjustmentType is DEPRECIATION_METHOD.
api_arguments.Reason: string: Description or reason for the cost adjustment.

functionality: Records an adjustment to a fixed asset's cost, life, salvage value, or depreciation method.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Depreciation: Run Depreciation

api_arguments.BookTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Asset book for which to run depreciation.
api_arguments.RunMode: string: Depreciation run mode. Valid values: PREVIEW, FINAL. Use PREVIEW to validate before committing. Default: PREVIEW.
api_arguments.RerunFlag: string: Whether to rerun depreciation if already run for the period. Valid values: Y, N. Default: N.

functionality: Runs the depreciation process for all assets in a specified book and accounting period.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Asset Categories: List Asset Categories

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports MajorCategory, MinorCategory, BookTypeCode, AssetType, Status. Example: q=AssetType='CAPITALIZED' and Status='Active'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: books, defaultRules
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves asset categories that define default depreciation rules, accounts, and useful lives for grouped assets.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Mass Additions: List Mass Additions

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports BookTypeCode, QueueName, AssetCategoryId, BatchName, InvoiceId. Example: q=BookTypeCode='OPS CORP' and QueueName='NEW'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves mass addition records — payables invoice lines that have been transferred to Fixed Assets for capitalization.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Mass Additions: Post a Mass Addition

api_arguments.MassAdditionId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the mass addition record.
api_arguments.QueueName: [REQUIRED] string: Set to 'POST' to approve the mass addition for capitalization as a fixed asset.
api_arguments.AssetCategoryId: integer: Asset category to assign if not already set.
api_arguments.AssetDescription: string: Override description for the resulting asset.
api_arguments.DatePlacedInService: string: Override date placed in service. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Life: integer: Override useful life in months.
api_arguments.LocationId: integer: Location of the resulting asset.
api_arguments.AssignedTo: integer: PersonId of the employee assigned to the asset.

functionality: Updates and approves a mass addition record to capitalize it as a fixed asset.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Revaluations: Revalue an Asset

api_arguments.BookTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Asset book for the revaluation.
api_arguments.CategoryId: integer: Limit revaluation to a specific asset category.
api_arguments.AssetId: integer: Limit revaluation to a specific asset.
api_arguments.RevaluationDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date of the revaluation. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.RevaluationRule: [REQUIRED] string: Revaluation method. Valid values: PERCENT_ADJUST (adjust by percentage) or REPLACEMENT_VALUE (set to a new replacement value).
api_arguments.RevaluationPercent: number: Percentage adjustment. Required when RevaluationRule is PERCENT_ADJUST.
api_arguments.ReplacementValue: number: New gross replacement value. Required when RevaluationRule is REPLACEMENT_VALUE.
api_arguments.RevalReserveAccount: string: Account segment string for the revaluation reserve.

functionality: Revalues one or more fixed assets to reflect fair market value, posting the adjustment to the revaluation reserve.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP Fixed Assets - Physical Inventory: List Physical Inventory Lines

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports BookTypeCode, LocationId, AssetCategoryId, ReconciliationStatus. Example: q=BookTypeCode='OPS CORP' and ReconciliationStatus='UNRECONCILED'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves physical inventory lines used to reconcile actual asset locations and quantities against the asset register.
